description: This PHP class defines a controller named DeleteSavepointController within the OrangeHRM framework. It handles HTTP requests to delete database savepoints, utilizing methods from the framework's request and response objects, and interacts with a database backup service.

classes.name: DeleteSavepointController
classes.description: Controller to handle deletion of database savepoints via HTTP requests within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP request to delete specified savepoints and returns response indicating success status.
